pylons_vi: 2 tháp hình cánh buồm gồm 3 cột (cột chính cong ở giữa, 2 cột sau nghiêng), giằng thép 3 tầng, cao ≈107,5 m từ bệ
pylons_en: 2 sail pylons of three columns (curved central mast, two inclined rear columns), steel bracing at 3 levels, ≈107.5 m above the pile cap

model3d.notes: 125 + 300 + 125 m, 26.5 m prestressed-concrete box, 120 semi-fan stays: 20 per side in one central plane over the main span, 2 × 20 over each side span (TEDI). Three-column 'sail' pylons, 107.5 m above the pile cap (TEDI; 111 m in press), RC lower shafts and composite-steel upper section with steel bracing at three levels. Geometry scaled from the user-supplied official render, TEDI's near-elevation render and the ground-breaking stage screen; deck ≈30 m above water with a ≈4 m crest estimated.

pylon_custom.description: Sail pylon of three columns: a curved central mast (convex toward the main span, tip leaning back) carrying the single main-span stay plane, and two straighter rear columns at the deck edges, set back toward the side span and leaning inward, carrying the two side-span planes; joined by steel struts at three levels; RC lower shafts to a pile cap.
